    int[] pi, dd, bb;
    int[] uu, vv, uv, cost;
    int[] cap;
    int[] qq;
    int nq = 1, head, cnt;
    boolean[] inq;

    void init() {
        adj = new ArrayList[n];
        for (int u = 0; u < n; u++)
            adj[u] = new ArrayList<>();
        pi = new int[n];
        dd = new int[n];
        bb = new int[n];
        qq = new int[nq];
        inq = new boolean[n];
        uu = new int[m];
        vv = new int[m];
        uv = new int[m];
        cost = new int[m];
        cap = new int[m * 2];
        m = 0;
    }

        int h = m++;
        uu[h] = u;
        vv[h] = v;
        uv[h] = u ^ v;
        cost[h] = w;
        cap[h << 1] = c;
        adj[u].add(h << 1);
        adj[v].add(h << 1 | 1);
    }

    void enqueue(int v) {
        if (inq[v]) return;
        if (head + cnt == nq) {
            if (cnt * 2 <= nq)
                System.arraycopy(qq, head, qq, 0, cnt);
            else {
                int[] tmp = new int[nq *= 2];
                System.arraycopy(qq, head, tmp, 0, cnt);
                qq = tmp;
            }
            head = 0;
        }
        qq[head + cnt++] = v;
        inq[v] = true;
    }

    int dequeue() {
        int u = qq[head++];
        cnt--;
        inq[u] = false;
        return u;

            int d = dd[u] + 1;

                if (cap[h_] > 0) {
                    int h = h_ >> 1;
                    int p = pi[u] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? cost[h] : -cost[h]);
                    int v = u ^ uv[h];

                        pi[v] = p;

            cap[h_]--;
            cap[h_ ^ 1]++;
        }

        graph[v].add(b);
